title: Hematology and oncology
audience: a medical student in the preclinical years
purpose: Integrate hematopoiesis and the blood smear, the anemias, hemoglobinopathies, hemostasis and bleeding disorders, thrombosis and anticoagulation, transfusion, leukemias, lymphomas and plasma-cell disorders, principles of oncology, cancer drugs and oncologic emergencies.

blocks.deliverable: Distinguish iron deficiency, thalassemia and anemia of inflammation.
Work up a macrocytic and a hemolytic anemia.
Interpret the PT, aPTT and platelet count.
Recognize tumor lysis syndrome and spinal cord compression.
Submit the project; take an unseen 150 minute final in week 14.

project: Anemia and coagulation workshop: interpret supplied blood counts, smear descriptions and coagulation panels, and propose the next test for each.
completion: finish the project, take the week 7 midterm and week 14 cumulative final, then complete a new cumulative assessment after 1 to 2 weeks. Explain one major idea aloud without notes.
